{"metadata":{"description":"DSH 插件：对话节点导航条（右缘节点串快速跳转 user 消息）。官方 bundle 插件，dsh plugin --profile web add 安装","id":"gh:1330041615","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-navbar","slug":"vlln/dsh-navbar","topics":["dsh","dsh-plugin","plugin","ui"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DSH 插件：对话节点导航条（右缘节点串快速跳转 user 消息）。官方 bundle 插件，dsh plugin --profile web add 安装"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"**ARCHIVED (read-only)** — The official DSH web shell shipped a built-in Turn navigation rail in the"},{"id":"p2s2","text":" **0.1.2 series** (npm `@deepseek-ai/dsh` ≥ 0.1.2-rc.1; upstream `feat(ui-chat): full-session turn r"},{"id":"p2s3","text":"ail with load-and-jump`, b3064cca): a `TurnNavigator` rail with hover previews, click-to-jump, readi"},{"id":"p2s4","text":"ng-position tracking, and jump-loads for unloaded turns. The core capabilities of this plugin are no"},{"id":"p2s5","text":"w covered by the host, so this repository is archived. Historical implementation remains in `docs/` "},{"id":"p2s6","text":"and the git history."},{"id":"p3s1","text":"中文 | English"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"navbar"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Conversation node navigation rail: jump between user messages from the node strip on the right edge "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"of the conversation — hover to preview, click to jump"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"An evenly spaced node strip along the right edge of the conversation area (one node per user message"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"): the active pill follows your reading position, hovering shows a preview card (truncated at 6 line"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"s), clicking smooth-scrolls with a brand-blue highlight ring, more than 30 nodes switch to a fixed 3"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"0-node window with count badges (↑N/N↓) at the ends showing how many are hidden, it stays invisible "},{"id":"p6s5","text":"until hovered, and it auto-hides only when no user message is loaded — in that case it automatically"},{"id":"p6s6","text":" loads earlier history until at least one user message appears (or history runs out). Implements the"},{"id":"p6s7","text":" dsh-external/issues#144 spec. Form: an official **bundle plugin** (`dsh.bundle` + dshClient channel"},{"id":"p6s8","text":", **browser-only**, empty Node half), 0 patches."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Preview"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| Feature | Description |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Node navigation rail | Vertical node strip on the right edge of the conversation area, one dot nod"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"e per user message |
| Follows reading position | The active pill (22px brand-blue capsule) moves wi"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"th your current reading position |
| Hover preview | Hovering a node shows a message preview card (6"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"-line truncation, matching the official HoverCard look) |
| Continuous hover | The entire rail (incl"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"uding the gaps between nodes) responds to hover continuously: the preview switches to the nearest no"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"de and the corresponding pill elongates (gray) to indicate the click target — no dead zones |
| Scro"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"ll-wheel switching | With the cursor over the rail, scrolling the wheel moves up/down one message (b"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"locking conversation-area scrolling) |
| Click to jump | The whole rail is clickable (including gaps"},{"id":"p10s9","text":", jumping to the nearest node) plus an enlarged pill hit area — no need to precisely aim at tiny dot"},{"id":"p10s10","text":"s |
| Fixed window + count badges | More than 30 nodes show a fixed 30-node window (the active node "},{"id":"p10s11","text":"stays centered, clamped at the ends); count badges (↑N / N↓) at the window ends show how many are hi"},{"id":"p10s12","text":"dden — the visible node count stays constant. Pinned golden discs always stay visible (the window ex"},{"id":"p10s13","text":"pands to include them) |
| Load earlier history | An ↑ button pinned at the top of the rail (visible"},{"id":"p10s14","text":" only while the conversation has older history): click to load earlier messages — it forwards to the"},{"id":"p10s15","text":" official load-older control, so your reading position is preserved. Hovering it instantly shows a h"},{"id":"p10s16","text":"int card in the same style as the node previews (the official HoverCard look) |
| Auto-hide | Not sh"},{"id":"p10s17","text":"own with no user message loaded (or on non-conversation pages). With zero user messages loaded, the "},{"id":"p10s18","text":"rail **automatically loads earlier history** until at least one user message appears (or history is "},{"id":"p10s19","text":"exhausted) — so the rail always has something to navigate |
| Message pin | 📌 button on the assistan"},{"id":"p10s20","text":"t action bar (between copy and Good response); pinned turns render as a golden slim elliptical disc "},{"id":"p10s21","text":"in the rail (always visible, the preview card carries a 📌 badge, clicking jumps straight to the pinn"},{"id":"p10s22","text":"ed reply), persisted per session |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Zero data-channel dependencies: driven only by official anchor attributes (`data-time-hover-root`, o"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"n user rows since 0806) — no polling, no routing, no tools."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"**Recommended: one-line install from git source** (build artifacts are committed, so git source does"},{"id":"p13s2","text":" not trigger a build):"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Or from a local directory (when you have the source): `git clone`, then `cd dsh-navbar && dsh plugin"},{"id":"p15s2","text":" --profile web add .`."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"**Restart web** after installing for it to take effect; you can disable/enable it in the Plugins pan"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"el on the Settings page."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Works out of the box — no commands, no tools. The node rail appears on the right edge of the convers"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"ation page (Chat view); hover for a preview, click to jump. Animations are disabled under `prefers-r"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"t view); hover for a preview, click to jump. Animations are disabled under `prefers-reduced-motion`."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"**Pin**: hover an assistant message's action bar and click 📌 to pin that reply — the corresponding t"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"urn's navigation node becomes a golden slim elliptical disc (click to jump straight to that reply; t"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"he preview card shows a 📌 badge and the reply text). Pin state is saved per session in browser local"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"Storage and survives refreshes; click again to unpin."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"**Load earlier history**: when the open conversation still has older messages (its history window is"},{"id":"p20s2","text":" not fully loaded), an ↑ button sits at the very top of the node rail. Click it to load the earlier "},{"id":"p20s3","text":"messages — the rail then grows new nodes at the top. The button hides automatically once all history"},{"id":"p20s4","text":" is loaded, and is disabled while a load is in flight. Hovering it instantly shows a hint card in th"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"e same style as the node previews (the official HoverCard look), and it reads "Loading…" while a loa"},{"id":"p20s6","text":"d is in flight. The click is forwarded to the official load-older control, so your current reading p"},{"id":"p20s7","text":"osition is preserved (no content jump)."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- client: `src/client/index.ts` (self-rendered DOM + official anchor contract; the pin button uses t"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"he official `conversation.chat.assistant-actions` slot, with React provided by the client runtime; c"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"tx services accessed must be declared in the plugin object's `inject`)
- Node half: `src/index.mjs` "},{"id":"p23s4","text":"(empty apply, the bundle mount carrier)"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"MIT License (an example plugin in the DSH ecosystem)."}],"truncated":false}
